title: Finite evaluation normalization of strict-system compact-support restriction
statement: Fix $\ell\in\mathbf N$, finite commutative $\ell$-power-torsion coefficient sequences $B_\bullet,C_\bullet$, a compatible map $a$, schemes $X,Z,Y$, open $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$, $p:Z\to Y$, and a normalized comparison datum $d$ of [def-sp-system-compact-support-restriction-data]. Let $e_n$ and the normalized $e_nJ\cong J_ne_n$, $e_nP\cong P_ne_n$ be those of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], and let $e_nU_a\cong U_{a_n}e_n$ be the exact restriction evaluation of that datum. Define finite compatibility of $d$ to consist of the compatibility equations between the actual constant-coefficient maps and the canonical geometric ring pullback isomorphisms [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] on the finite-level constant-ring module categories [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]; finite open isomorphisms $J_{B_n}U_{a_n}\cong U_{a_n}J_{C_n}$ of the finite-level open extensions [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension], normalized by the original derived open-adjunction units [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization] and the specified derived inverse-image comparison [def-weil-pbc-ring-restriction-pullback-comparison]; and the following two equations. Evaluation of the open part of $d$, conjugated by these canonical evaluation identifications, is that finite open isomorphism. Evaluation of the proper part of $d$, conjugated by these identifications, is the inverse of the specified derived direct-image comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], with its canonical constant-ring pullback maps. The equations hold at every $n$ and every object of the ordinary unbounded derived category of entire strict systems. Finite compatibility makes no assertion that evaluation is faithful.
